# zhi2-flood-history
History query module in Suzhou Housing flood-control C-end H5 `src/stores/flood.ts`, handling remote inspection-record listing, counting, and detail.

## Module Structure
- `fetchHistoryRemote` calls `request` from `../utils/request`; with `{ raw: true }` the client returns the raw page `{ rows, total }`
- `countHistory` computes per-status counts from the fetched rows
- `getRecordAsync` (detail page) maps a row to a record via `inspectionRowToRecord` at line 464
- `inspectionRowToRecord` is the shared mapping used by both list and detail views

## Key Mappings
- `STAGE: { pre: '2', mid: '3', post: '4' }` maps inspection stage to the `inspectionStage` param (pre=2, mid=3, post=4)
- `KIND_BY_STAGE` maps the stage back to the record `kind`
- `bizState` is mapped to `status`; list and detail share the same `bizState`→`status` mapping and filter separation

## Testing
- Remote-mode tests mock `request` to lock the `bizState`→`status` mapping and the list/detail filter separation

# zentao-bug-writeback
Agent process to resolve and write back a ZenTao bug, using the `zentao-analyzer` skill.

## Workflow
- Load the `zentao-analyzer` skill to get the exact DBX write-back pattern
- The skill routes write-back through `zentao-resolve.mjs`, which prints the SQL transaction but does not execute it
- Execute the printed transaction via DBX

## SQL Transaction
- `UPDATE zt_bug`: set status=resolved, resolution=fixed, resolvedBy/lastEditedBy=tiany, assignedTo=openedBy, resolvedDate/lastEditedDate=NOW()
- `INSERT INTO zt_action`: 14 columns, `read` backtick, files NULL, vision 'rnd'

# zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c
Suzhou Housing flood-control C-end mobile query H5 project (GitLab suzhufang-fe/zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c), a uni-app Vue3 H5 frontend.

- uni-app Vue3 project; uni builds can take a while and are run in the background

# zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c
Suzhou Housing flood-control C-end mobile query H5 project (GitLab suzhufang-fe/zhi2-mobile-query-h5-c), a uni-app Vue3 H5 frontend.

## Pages & Layout
- home/index.vue has a global `.scroll-tabs` tab row container and a `BottomNav` component
- mine/index.vue layout uses `.user-card` (blue gradient), `.menu-card` (white), `.mine-body` (padding)
- mine page `.menu-card` and `.menu-row` are flex containers so skeleton rows lay out correctly

## Loading Pattern
- Uses a `loading` state gating content with `v-if="!loading"` and showing skeleton blocks while loading
- Skeleton screens added to home and mine pages, inserted before `BottomNav` (2026-11-09)

## Build & Environment
- uni-app Vue3 project; uni builds can take a while and are run in the background
- Worktree has no `node_modules`; a junction is created from the worktree's `node_modules` to the main repo's to avoid copying
- Build from worktree succeeds (exit 0), clean with no errors/warnings, `dist` produced (2026-11-09)

## Testing
- Vitest config includes `tests/**/*.test.ts` from the project root, so new tests placed at root `tests/` are picked up by `npm run test`
- `npm run test` runs vitest from `tools/testing` and also `uni build -m test`; the orchestrate tool pool has no shell-exec, so builds/tests run directly in-session
- Remote-mode tests mock `request` (from `../utils/request`) to lock the `bizState`→`status` mapping and list/detail filter separation without real APIs
